body: An adventure modpack with lots of QOL and RPG mods!! Enhances farming, overworld biomes, mobs, well ok everything! Contains the essential mod to make multiplayer server hosting easier. Also has mods that make the game run smoother! (hopefully) This is a heavyish modpack so please make sure to allocate enough memory! Please also make sure to enable the resource packs. As long as fresh animations is on the bottom, everything else should be good to go. Have fun! :3
